posts.text:
3 years ago I wrote this piece for @theatlantic.com about why we mustn’t take public health for granted.

This is long before this admin’s deep cuts to public health.

With the massive Cyclospora outbreak, I couldn’t help thinking about my own warning from the past.
posts.summary: Warns against neglecting public health infrastructure and funding

A brilliant essay by my friend @helenouyang.bsky.social in the New York Times Magazine.

Writing notes is one of my least favorite parts of working in the ER. But learning how to write them teaches physicians important skills.

What impact will AI have on that skill?
